technical.summary: Multiple RSI and MACD indicators show rising momentum with price above key EMAs, but weak ADX, absent volume confirmation, and conflicting trend structure signals limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 26 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (42% bearish vs 21% bullish); insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 219.5 crisis regime, imminent NFP event) creates severe near-term headwinds; earnings in 26 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI rising, MACD bullish crossover, and price above 200-EMA provide technical momentum signals with defined support at 101.60 for risk management.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 219.5, inverted yield curve), zero fundamental conviction, absent volume confirmation, weak ADX, earnings in 26 days, and conflicting trend structure (Hull MA bearish, price in Ichimoku cloud) create overwhelming headwinds that invalidate technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (RSI rising, MACD crossover) exists but is severely undermined by macro crisis regime (VIX 219.5, inverted yield curve) and zero fundamental conviction with earnings 26 days away.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in crisis mode with inverted yield curve and extreme VIX will likely override technical signals; earnings event in 26 days creates binary risk that invalidates swing trade thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical weakness (no ADX, no volume, Hull MA bearish, price in cloud) combined with macro crisis and fundamental void create overwhelming consensus against entry
decision.portfolio_note: Already 7 positions open in Energy sector; adding MPC would increase concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without offsetting conviction.
